# ⚡ 21 Gradient Generator Engines & 24 Silhouettes Catalog

`fractalthemer` provides 21 procedural gradient synthesis engines and 24 vector silhouette forms divided into 4 core paradigms:

---

## 🌊 1. Fields (7 Engines)

| Engine | Description | Primary Controls |
|---|---|---|
| `flow` | 2D Simplex turbulence displacement noise with draggable color emitters. | `Scale` (10–100%), `Distortion` (0–100%), `Swirl` (0–100%) |
| `sky` | Rayleigh horizon atmospheric scattering with sun elevation. | `Elevation` (0°–90°) |
| `aurora` | Shimmering Northern Lights ray curtains with sinusoidal folding. | `Lights Intensity`, `Fold`, `Spread` |
| `mesh` | Interpolated multi-node Bezier mesh with draggable canvas anchor points. | `Scale`, `Distortion` |
| `still` | Clean motionless optical vignette depth wash. | `Soften`, `Noise` |
| `retro` | Vintage analog filmic chromatic wash with warm tone-mapping. | `Soften`, `Noise` |
| `ios` | Frosted glassmorphic optical blur backdrop with saturated ambient glow. | `Soften`, `Noise` |

---

## 💈 2. Stripes (7 Engines)

| Engine | Description | Primary Controls |
|---|---|---|
| `linear` | High-precision multi-stop directional linear gradient. | `Angle` (0–360°) |
| `stripes` | Crisp parallel spectral bands. | `Count` (4–64) |
| `bars` | Soundwave equalizer array with animated bar dynamics. | `Count` (4–64), `Speed` |
| `columns` | Prismatic vertical light sweeps. | `Count` (4–64) |
| `prism` | Spectral chromatic dispersion simulating white light through glass. | `Count`, `Speed` |
| `waves` | Sinuous undulating harmonic wave layers. | `Wave count`, `Speed` |
| `lines` | Dimensional flowing ribbon tubes with path presets (*Snake, Drops, Loops, Ribbon, Doodle, Wander, Waves, Echo*). | `Thickness` (6–64px) |

---

## 🔮 3. Objects (7 Engines)

| Engine | Description | Primary Controls |
|---|---|---|
| `rings` | Concentric circular acoustic ripples with exponential decay. | `Pins`, `Radius` |
| `pixel` | Retro 8-bit quantized modular pixel grid. | `Cell Size` (16–80px) |
| `blocks` | Structured polygonal and modular tiled grid cells. | `Cell Size` (16–80px) |
| `beehive` | Hexagonal cellular honeycomb matrix. | `Cell Size` (16–80px) |
| `balls` | Floating radial metaballs with liquid gravitational blending. | `Pins`, `Radius` |
| `radial` | Multi-point radial spotlight emitters with circular/elliptical ratios. | `Origin X/Y`, `Radius` |
| `conic` | 360° angular conic sweeps around a central focal point. | `Angle` (0–360°) |

---

## 🎭 4. Forms (24 SVG Vector Silhouettes)

The Forms engine renders crisp, scale-independent vector silhouette paths with multi-stop linear gradient fills:

1. **Arch** (Modern curved portal)
2. **Clover** (4-lobed organic flower)
3. **Heart** (Geometric heart form)
4. **Drapery** (Fluted column curvature)
5. **4-Leaf** (Rotated quad-petal leaf)
6. **Sunburst** (8-ray geometric sunburst)
7. **Flower** (Curved 4-petal blossom)
8. **Starburst** (12-pointed radial burst)
9. **Cross** (Greek orthogonal cross)
10. **Ring** (Concentric donut ring)
11. **Sparkle** (4-point sparkle diamond)
12. **Horizontal Stripes** (Equalizer stripe bands)
13. **Dome** (Semicircular arch dome)
14. **Propeller** (Rotational 2-blade paddle)
15. **Squiggle** (Sinusoidal vertical ribbon)
16. **Flower-8** (8-lobed blossom)
17. **Teardrop** (Liquid droplet silhouette)
18. **Circle** (Pure centered disc)
19. **Pebble** (Organic asymmetrical pebble)
20. **Eye-Ring** (Cat-eye ring aperture)
21. **Crescent** (Waxing crescent moon)
22. **Star** (5-point star)
23. **X-Pill** (Rotated cross pill)
24. **Wave** (Smooth harmonic wave ribbon)
